summary: AI OKTO Corp., a Cyprus-domiciled foreign private issuer in deep-sea freight (formerly AI Mar Inc.), furnished a Form 6-K attaching Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2: unaudited interim condensed combined carve-out financial statements of its predecessor for the six months ended June 30, 2026, plus management's discussion and analysis. The carve-out balance sheet shows $50.65M total assets, $0.73M liabilities and $49.92M net parent investment; revenue fell to $4.21M from $7.53M, with net income of $0.19M. This is routine periodic financial reporting, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed.
